questions.question_text: What is one major advantage of starting a digital side hustle for teens, as discussed in Section 1?

options.text: It requires a large budget to start.
It offers a massive global reach compared to offline hustles.
It can only be done during fixed working hours.
It limits your audience to your local area.Correct Answer:b) It offers a massive global reach compared to offline hustles.

questions.question_text: According to Section 2, what is an important step in setting up a strong online presence?

options.text: Posting blurry photos to keep things casual.
Using a consistent, catchy username across platforms for branding.
Sharing personal details like your home address in your bio.
Posting only once a year to avoid spamming.Correct Answer:b) Using a consistent, catchy username across platforms for branding.

questions.question_text: Which of the following is a popular online side hustle for teens mentioned in Section 3?

options.text: Opening a physical store in a mall.
Selling digital products like printable planners on Etsy.
Working a full-time office job remotely.
Buying expensive equipment to start a business.Correct Answer:b) Selling digital products like printable planners on Etsy.

questions.question_text: In Section 4, what is the primary benefit of using free tools like Canva and Google Sheets for your hustle?

options.text: They require advanced technical skills to use.
They help save money and time while looking professional.
They are only useful for offline businesses.
They cost a lot but guarantee success.Correct Answer:b) They help save money and time while looking professional.

questions.question_text: What is a key online safety tip for teens from Section 5?

options.text: Share your full name and address on public profiles to build trust.
Click on every link sent in DMs to check for opportunities.
Use Two-Factor Authentication (2FA) to secure your accounts.
Keep the same password for all apps for easy recall.Correct Answer:c) Use Two-Factor Authentication (2FA) to secure your accounts.
